testCase.name: TBS-CFL-001_1
testCase.title: Normal procedure with satisfactory control (no OoTra)
testCase.description:
This scenario describes messages exchanged based on the core flow scenario (CFL) of the DDNTA Main Document. No Customs Office of Transit and no Customs Office of Exit for Transit are involved. Additionally, the Destination Control results received by the Office of Departure are "Satisfactory (A1)".

DDNTA L3 related scenario: T-TRA-CFL-M-001.
testCase.note:
TBS-CFL-001: This test scenario can only executed by EU MS as there is no office of transit defined in the CD001C.
This scenario simulates the exchange of message(s) after the end of the Transitional Period.
TBS-CFL-001_1: Country type for each customs office role per NA testing:
MS {OoDesD}.
testCase.preconditions:
TBS-CFL-001: Prior to the execution of this scenario - the CTA operator must configure the instantiation data as follows:
TPendDate = Execution day - 1 day
